task: Review PR #5175 and drive it to closure; found the PR carried a zero-diff branch, so reimplemented the described pr-autofix tier field fix and added a producer field-contract test
lessons: Derive a producer's output schema statically and check consumers against it. Parse the producer with ast to determine envelope level and top-level keys, then fail the build on any consumer read that disagrees.
Avoid: Trusting a PR body's description of completed work without reading the diff. Check git diff against the merge base before reading the description.
Avoid: Using a Success field to detect the Data envelope. Key envelope detection off the github_core.output emitter call, which is the thing that actually wraps the payload.
Avoid: Fixing a silent-fallback bug at the instance instead of the class. Ship a gate covering every read of the same shape, not only the one that was reported.
